name: wyrd-backend
description: Tooling for the Wyrd Supabase backend (tests and offline validation only; Edge Functions run on Deno).

scripts.check:functions: cd supabase/functions && npx --yes deno@2 check --config deno.json evaluate-completion/index.ts generate-chronicle/index.ts notify/index.ts _shared/shared.test.ts _shared/keys.test.ts _shared/engine/engine.test.ts _shared/engine/heuristic.test.ts
scripts.lint:functions: cd supabase/functions && npx --yes deno@2 lint --config deno.json
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run validate:sql && npm run check:functions
